meta.title: A surrogate bid appears to the vendor as their own bid
gaps: Open the prepared event as the invited vendor to inspect an existing surrogate bid without submitting or changing it.
Assert that the vendor portal shows the surrogate bid as their own bid at the entered price.
Assert that the vendor portal clearly identifies who entered the surrogate bid.
